NewText: Born and raised among the Chukchi peoples of far eastern Russia, Omryn began mercenary life helping M.E.R.C. track smugglers through the wilds of Siberia. It gave him a taste of adventure, so he left Russia and joined the French Foreign Legion, eventually claiming France as his home. His excellent marksmanship, uncanny perception, stolid manner, and mastery of English, French, and Russian languages earned him respect as well as commendations. Never an ambitious or energetic man, Omryn grew tired of full-time service and took the first opportunity to become an A.I.M. mercenary, working where and when it suited him.

In combat, Kevi earned the name "Fauda" because she alternates between being recklessly aggressive and overly cautious.
